_comment: Budgets for Gate 6b (Lighthouse). Measured on 2026-10-30 against the
pinned upstream theme. Upstream Chirpy itself does not reach 95 on mobile
(68 performance, 6.2 s LCP) or on accessibility (92, see D-20), so the
absolute budgets apply to the desktop profile, where the port matches the
original (99 vs 100 performance), and the mobile profile is compared with
the Jekyll build instead. See D-21 in docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
